coordinate_order.description: All ground-truth and predicted points are represented as [y, x], where y is row/height and x is column/width.

conversion: Concatenate positive and negative points as total cell points.
Swap columns from [x, y] to [y, x].
BCData.center_definition: Original dataset point annotation, converted from [x, y] to [y, x].

conversion: For each nonzero instance id, find all pixels belonging to that instance.
Compute mean row coordinate as center_y.
Compute mean column coordinate as center_x.
CoNIC.center_definition: Pixel centroid of each instance mask.
CoNIC.code_equivalent: ys, xs = np.where(inst_map == inst_id); point = [float(ys.mean()), float(xs.mean())]

conversion: Parse each Region in the XML file.
Read all Vertex X/Y coordinates in the region.
Compute the mean of all polygon vertices as the cell center.
MoNuSeg.center_definition: Mean coordinate of polygon boundary vertices, not rasterized-mask centroid.

localization_metric.true_positive: A predicted point is counted as TP if its distance to an unused GT point is <= radius.
localization_metric.false_positive: Predicted points not matched to any GT point.
localization_metric.false_negative: GT points not matched by any prediction.

counting_metric.MAE: mean absolute count error over images
counting_metric.MSE: sqrt(mean squared count error over images)
